name: Zoku Ryoujoku Sou
source:
One year has passed.
New apartment complex has been built by the station, and old facility faces financial challenges due to lack of demand. Main character needs to infiltrate this new building and learn its secrets to protect his old workplace.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一年过去了。车站旁建起新的公寓楼，旧设施因需求不足面临经营困境。主人公必须潜入新大楼，查明其中秘密，以保护原来的工作场所。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
